assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one original gameplay-mechanic illustration for an existing game research website card, never official game art. Wide landscape 16:9. Match the attached reference images' early-2000s Japanese PC game cel illustration: thick confident dark ink contours, crisp hand-painted color, two to three hard-edged shadow tones, parchment ivory, dusty violet, muted teal, brick red and old gold, detailed drawn scenery and tactile materials. Full bleed, central 80% contains essential subjects, main mechanic readable at 320 pixels. Create an original miniature automated factory on a dark wooden research table at twilight: a sweeping conveyor belt brings copper ore from an open quarry at left to three large teal furnaces, then brass articulated inserter arms transfer plates into an assembly machine at center-right, while another belt carries finished gears back toward foreground storage. Parallel belts, branching splitter and visible production bottleneck, a tiny original engineer beside a blueprint, warm furnace gold contrasted with blue-violet windows. Factory logistics and transformation dominate, not character portrait. No lettering, no numbers, no logo, no UI, no border, no collage, no official characters.
